Frequently Asked Questions Financing Our Process Services Do you offer financing options for pool construction? We work closely with trusted financing partners to offer our customers the best financing options available. What are the benefits of financing through your partners? Our financing partners can offer competitive rates and flexible terms, making it easier for you to afford the pool of your dreams without breaking the bank. ‍ How can I apply for financing? Applying for financing is simple. Just click on the links provided to access our partners' portals, fill out the required forms, and find out if you’re approved for financing—all in just a few clicks! ‍ What variables affect pool cost? The materials you choose can have an impact on the construction costs. Adding on extras like spas, outdoor living areas, and large decking areas will also change the costs. If your yard has tight access and we have to bring in smaller equipment to dig, that will increase the amount of time we spend and also increase your costs. One thing that never changes is we do the same structure and gunite thickness regardless of your budget. ‍ What does a new pool cost? There is no set answer to this question because every pool is uniquely sized and custom to your needs. As a custom design build company, our basic pool projects starts at $70,000 and go up from there. ‍ What is involved in the drafting and permitting process? The drafting process refines the initial design into detailed construction plans. This involves drafting, engineering (if applicable), obtaining permits, and scheduling a pre-construction meeting with the city. We ensure all necessary steps are completed for a smooth construction process. ‍ Can you explain the construction phase in detail? Construction involves various steps including site preparation, excavation, plumbing, concrete work, installation of structures, electrical and gas lines, as well as finishing touches like tiling and landscaping. Each step is carefully executed to bring your vision to life. ‍ ‍ What happens during the design consultation? Our design consultant will meet with you to understand your vision for your outdoor space. We'll discuss budget, take measurements, and use 3D design software to visualize your project. You'll also have the opportunity to choose materials from our showroom. ‍ What pool upgrades and backyard features do you offer? Our pool upgrades include automation systems, energy-efficient pumps, filters, pool vacuums, and pool covers. For complete backyard solutions, we provide a wide range of features such as arbors, cabanas, outdoor kitchens, fireplaces, fire pits, patios, decks, and more. ‍ ‍ Can I request your services if I live outside of the specified counties? At this time, our services are primarily available within the North Texas area. However, if you reside outside of our service area, we may be able to accommodate your project depending on its scope and location. Do you handle pool damage repair and renovations? Yes, we specialize in pool damage repair and backyard renovations. From coping and plaster to tile work and waterfalls, our team can rejuvenate older pools and transform your backyard into a luxurious outdoor retreat. Contact us for all your pool and backyard renovation needs. ‍ What support and warranty services do you offer after construction? We provide comprehensive support for your pool and outdoor space. If you encounter any issues or require repairs covered under warranty, simply contact us for assistance. Our team is dedicated to ensuring your complete satisfaction with our work. ‍ What services do you offer for pools and backyard transformations? We offer a wide range of services including pool equipment repair, pool upgrades, custom pool building, pool replacements, outdoor living space design and construction, as well as complete backyard transformations. Our goal is to create your dream outdoor space. ‍ ‍ Where do you provide your services? We are passionate about building complete backyards for families in the North Texas area, including Tarrant, Parker, Palo Pinto, Hood, Somervell, Johnson, Young, Jack, Wise, and Denton counties. ‍ ‍ Spring Savings are happening now. reviews.text: The Complete Back yard built us a great pool, they built us the best pool we have ever seen in a persons back yard.  It’s the level of a resort type pool. They did a wonderful job and if I was gonna build another pool tomorrow the complete back yard would be my first call.
reviews.author: Duke Miller

reviews.text: The Complete Back Yard company put our pool/extended patio in last year and we could not be happier.   They are extremely professional and the job was completed ahead of scheduled.   They truly did complete our back yard and we are so thankful we decided to go with them.
reviews.author: Melissa Davidson

reviews.text: Our pool is 25 years old this summer. If the sun is shinning and the water is warm , you can find me in my pool. If it's a nice day or evening, I'll be sitting by it. We have had no major problems whatsoever. My pool holds 44,000 gals and we paid $28,000 25 yrs ago! I'm so glad we got it.
reviews.author: Charlie Box

reviews.text: We enlisted the services of TCB to redesign our backyard. We knew we wanted something that was not only functional but that also looked great. We knew we did not want a pool as the yard was too small for that. With the help of their design team we came up with plans. TCB went through getting all the permits we needed. The construction phase took less time than we expected and the PM, Dave, was great to work with. The entire staff at TCB was wonderful. If we had questions they got us answers. Communication was open on both sides and that made working with them all the better. We didn't have to ask for updates, they were providing them. If you're looking to have your backyard remade, I would highly recommend The Complete Backyard!
reviews.author: Angel PinaHardin

reviews.text: Eric with the complete backyard was awesome to work with. The pool turned out great. We've enjoyed it immensely. Thank you so much to The Complete Backyard. We are happy we chose y'all to build our pool for us!
reviews.author: Jonathan Rothchild

reviews.text: We used TCB to design & build our pool. RJ and Gilbert were great to work with from design to construction. They were patient, informative & had great communication with us all the way. We love our pool!
reviews.author: Kathi Uptain

reviews.text:
The complete backyard designed our pool exactly how we wanted it. Including  hot tub, waterfall and pavers . Everyone we dealt with were very helpful and professional from beginning to end.
We had the pool built during construction of our home. So they worked with with our contractor really well and had to deal with the “pandemic “ and material shortage.
They managed to get it done in a timely manner.
There were a couple minor problems .
We called or sent an email and they took care of in a timely manor.
I have been in construction for over 40 years and have dealt with many contractors .
The Complete Backyard is definitely up at the top and would highly recommend them , they did a great job.
reviews.author: Mark Welch

reviews.text: We had The Complete Backyard design and install our new pool while we were building our new home. As with all construction projects there were hiccups along the way, but The Complete Backyard was on top of it and corrected any items that came up.  Took a little longer than anticipated but that was more of a supply chain problem than The Complete Backyard.  Overall the project turned out great and was a success.
reviews.author: Chris Tribble

reviews.text: We are extremely pleased with our pool, deck and pergola. The entire process from initial consult and design through completion was painless. Dave was a professional and knowledgeable project manager who kept us on track. I highly recommend TCB and Dave as PM.
reviews.author: Nina Hays

reviews.text:
We are so happy we chose the team at The Complete Backyard to build our beautiful pool and patio! From the moment we met with them to the day the pool was done, they were in constant communication with us on our timeline and what to expect each day. Our pool was completed within the projected time, even after we made some add ons and changes during the process. We absolutely love the end result of our pool and patio with outdoor kitchen!

We highly recommend going with TCB for a stress-free pool build experience! And make sure to ask for RJ and Dave!
reviews.author: Lindsay Lutz

reviews.text: The Complete Backyard did an excellent job on our pool and backyard. RJ was very patient as I continuously changed by mind on design details. Amanda was wonderful on helping me narrow down materials based on my personality.  Dave was an awesome project manager. Made sure everything was done perfect the first time. I really appreciate his attention to detail. Our backyard looks great, performs well, and we've had no issues one year later. We heard that the Complete Backyard was known for quality, and they lived up to their reputation. The construction process was smooth as progress and next steps were well-communicated. Highly recommend TCB.
reviews.author: Kimberly

reviews.text: Well constructed & well done. It should be noted that we were not looking for the fastest or cheapest pool build, but we asked every pool bid to design it like it was their own backyard. The TCB pool, firepit & deck finish have been well used, without concern of elementary school-aged kids trying to see whether they can break it, and it looks fantastic.
reviews.author: Jeff Weaver

reviews.text: TCB was amazing to work with - the entire staff and team were excellent and brought our vision to life with a focus on quality.  Extra shout out to Eric G who was our GC.  He was beyond exceptional!!!
reviews.author: Ben Brown

reviews.text: This was our first pool and we were very anxious regarding the process and final outcome.   Fortunately we were blessed to select The Complete Backyard as our builder.  They began the process by measuring our backyard then providing a CAD rendering of what we could expect as the results.  We are pleased to share that the results are as they provided us in the rendering!   The Complete Backyard truly has a TEAM attitude which is one of customer servitude.  During the building we never needed to have a “serious” meeting as they listened to us and met our needs without arguments…   Now that is very different from our previous experiences with builders!   In summary, we not only recommend The Complete Backyard but would, without question, use them again!
reviews.author: Rodney Vestal

reviews.text:
This was our first pool experience and we had heard so many horror stories from people who had built pools with other builders who took money and ghosted their clients. So we were very nervous when we began this project. We knew a friend who had used TCB and had a wonderful experience, so we included them with the other pool builder interviews we conducted. After speaking with them and other builders, we felt confident in choosing TCB to complete our project. From design to finish, we couldn’t be happier. They were amazing to work with. Communication was on point throughout the process. Our Project Manager, Chris, was onsite to ensure things were getting done right the first time and addressed any questions or concerns immediately. We couldn’t be happier with this company and would recommend them to anyone who is looking to build a pool and wants that piece of mind knowing it’s going to be done right and the pool will be built to last. My friend who used them built theirs a couple years ago and TCB has been great with communication post build as well. I take comfort in knowing they will be around when I need them and won’t ghost me now that they have built our pool and have collected their money. This is an honorable company. You won’t regret choosing them to build your happy place!!

~Sabrina & Kenny Morrison
reviews.author: Brooklyn Morrison

reviews.text:
The Complete Backyard has built two pools for us over the last 15 years. Once again, they have outdone themselves. We wanted a simple but modern lap pool with clean lines and features; that is exactly what they delivered. Their customer service, communication, scheduling, and ability to accommodate a few last minute changes made our project flow smoothly from beginning to end. Each member of The Complete Backyard team brought something unique to the project. Thank you, Ross, Rene, and Phillip. We love our pool.
Manny and Marsha
reviews.author: Marsha Triana

reviews.text: The Complete Backyard was fantastic! As a family who has never had a pool before, putting in a pool was very intimidating. They walked us through each step and were very open regarding the process. We’re very satisfied!
reviews.author: Hope Olsen

reviews.text:
The TCB team has been very professional, from start to finish, and helpful. We had to have our original (30+ yr old) pool demo’s and replaced with a new one. The timeline was spot on, communication with the project manager was excellent, and most importantly, we are very pleased with the finished product.
We highly recommend TCB!
You get what you pay for!!!!
reviews.author: Stacey Taylor

reviews.text: Buying a pool and choosing the right company is stressful because of the investment. We made the right choice with CB!!! Professional, kept informed throughout the process. And upgrades that I was unsure during our consultation ended up being well worth the cost! Saltwater, in-floor cleaning system & cool decking…DO IT!!! Makes taking care of your pool EASY. No need for a pool service because of these additions. And these professional pictures are one of the extras they provide you when your pool is complete. Thanks CB.
reviews.author: joe guerrero

reviews.text:
I wanted to take a moment to express our heartfelt appreciation for the incredible work done by The Complete Backyard team. From start to finish, the entire process exceeded our expectations. RJ, Jesse, and everyone involved were courteous, professional, and incredibly patient, making the experience truly enjoyable.

The design phase was particularly enlightening and exciting. The team really listened to our input and came up with a fantastic design, going over options and features in great detail. It was clear that they were dedicated to creating something special for us. Amanda, the Project Manager,  worked with our HOA and kept everything moving along smoothly.

The construction crews were outstanding! They were always on time, professional, and their work was nothing short of amazing. They hand-carried the heavy stones and meticulously put the grotto together just as we had imagined it. Their skill and craftsmanship were evident, and they consistently cleaned up the area, which we greatly appreciated.

A special shout-out to our Project Manager Eric, who was simply amazing. He kept us informed of daily activities and the upcoming schedule, ensuring the project stayed on track despite the challenging cold and rainy season. His flexibility and understanding of our needs made a significant difference.

Finally, the Pool School after completion was concise but essential. They took the time to show us all the functions and maintenance needs, making our summers so much easier.

Thank you once again for an outstanding job! We couldn't be happier with the results.

Sincerely,
Dale & Tera Norcross
reviews.author: Robert Norcross

reviews.text: Ross and the team at "The Complete Backyard" are THE BEST!  We started down the (wrong) path with another company - focused only on a pool design.  When we learned of our mistake, we reached out to Ross. His team created the PERFECT design for our back yard - complete with a killer "champagne spa", an overhang and patio extension, and incredible lighting suggestions.  It's one of those rare experiences in life where the finished product is even better than the renderings.
reviews.author: Michael Wind

reviews.text:
The Complete Backyard did an amazing job on our project. Each team's attention to detail was impressive and we love every detail. Thank you Kyle & RJ for the perfect design! Thank you Dave for all you did managing the project.

If you are looking for a company to build your pool, you found them. The Complete Backyard a great group of people!
reviews.author: Jacque Weatherford

reviews.text:
We had a great experience with the TCB. The entire staff was attentive and friendly. Dave, the project manager, went above and beyond to meet our expectations.
From start to finish Dave was there to ensure everything ran smoothly. He was incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and always available to answer our questions or address any concerns.
Our pool was completed over a year ago, and I still feel like I could call him to help me if we were to run into any problems!
reviews.author: Kristin Penny

reviews.text: The guys did a great job from design, to permitting and construction was flawless. Highly recommend The Complete Backyard if you in the pool market.
reviews.author: Robert White

reviews.text: The complete backyard was an amazing company to work with during our pool design, installation and start-up.  They worked with us on all aspects of the design to create a product that we absolutely love.  The construction process went quick and was on-time with a fantastic supervisor.  He was very communicative and answered all of our questions which allowed us to understand what we were seeing.  At the end of the process they also did an excellent job making sure we knew how to use the new pool.  They have also been very responsive post-construction with any of our questions.  Highly recommend choosing TCB for your next backyard project.
reviews.author: Cory Eck

reviews.text: The Complete Backyard is nothing short of amazing. We were so pleased with everyone from the workers to the owner & absolutely love the finished product. A year out we are having some issues and the owner himself came out & is making things right. They really do take pride in their work and stand behind their word. You couldn’t ask for more.
reviews.author: Shelli Skipper

reviews.text:
We selected The Complete Backyard based on the reviews and recommendations of others, and following meeting with 4 different companies.  What stood out is their responsiveness and commitment to doing what they said they would do.

Our project was unusual in that it involved the removal and replacement of a large existing in ground pool which had been poorly built by another company and had shifted in the ground.  As a result the complexity of our build was significant, but they created a true backyard oasis for us, while also addressing the root cause of the problems that plagued the prior pool.

To be fully transparent, things didn't always go according to plan during our project and timings got extended due to weather and crew availability, but Ross, RJ and the broader team were responsive, available, and always sought to understand and address any concerns we had.  Most notably, we had two significant warranty issues following the completion of the project, after we had paid for the project in its entirety. Ross and team didn't hesitate and ultimately went above and beyond to quickly address these issues to our complete satisfaction, and have since followed up multiple times to simply make sure we remain completely happy with the outcome.

In the end, we will use The Complete Backyard again for enhancements to our little piece of paradise.  Our experience gives us confidence that they will do what they say and are truly committed to their customers, even beyond the projects end.
reviews.author: Ken Bradley

reviews.text: We are very happy with our pool. The crew was very professional and did great job with maintaining a clean work site and very responsive to all our questions. I would highly recommend The Complete Backyard.
reviews.author: Kelli Burns

reviews.text: The Complete Backyard was so knowledgeable and helped us design our dream backyard oasis! The crew was professional and had great workmanship. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: B

reviews.text: Working with the Complete Backyard was great start to finish. We met with Justin who designed the pool and he listened well, never rushed us. Ross was available and reviewed it all. The best process was the build, led by their construction manager, Rene. Rene cared, educated and took care of us and our project. The Complete Backyard uses good people, thinks ahead and stands behind their work. At the end of our large project, pool, slide, fire pit, outdoor kitchen and back porch addition, we wouldn’t change a thing! And would do it again with this group in a heartbeat!
reviews.author: Diana Frazier

reviews.text: The Complete Backyard built our amazing custom pool with tanning ledge and connected spa with rolled mosaic edge and waterfall. The results are simply spectacular. They worked tirelessly to meet our high expectations. We had very specific ideas about what we wanted, and they were extremely cooperative in meeting our goals. We morphed several ideas as they educated us about available tile, plaster finishes, fencing and decking. Their suggestions were excellent. We love our pool!!! We feel like we live in a resort!
reviews.author: Tim Saponas

reviews.text: Our project manager was great to work with and we were pleased with the results. We would definitely recommend The Complete Backyard again.
reviews.author: Cindy Bilicki

reviews.text: The Complete Backyard met each and every one of our expectations!  We were informed about what was happening every step of the way.  As we moved through the building process, the Complete Backyard team was available and always willing to answer questions that we had since it was our first pool install.  All employees and contractors were clean and respectful of the property.  I would recommend the Complete Backyard to everyone and anyone!  We couldn't be happier with the decision we made to go with The Complete Backyard.
reviews.author: Amy Pike

reviews.text: They turned out boring Backyard into an oasis! We now use it all the time I love having company over to enjoy it too
reviews.author: Tonya Arning

reviews.text:
If I could give them more stars I would!  This company has restored my faith in contract type work!!  Good, honest people still exist!!  Ross the owner runs a fantastic company with great people who work for him!  One thing I loved about him was that he was always honest about when things would be done or completed! He never promised something that didn’t happen!  Justin designed our pool and he did such a great job, exceeding our expectations and gave us a pool of our dreams!

I honestly want to build another pool with this company, they are truly a pleasure!  The complete backyard knows pools!!  Don’t hesitate to use them!  Do it!
reviews.author: Laura S

reviews.text: The Complete Backyard provided outstanding customer service.  They were professional, courteous and responsive to our needs.  We were completely satisfied with the quality of the workmanship. We now have a beautiful pool and backyard to enjoy!
reviews.author: Tony & Brenda Wilson

reviews.text: I am so thankful I found this company years ago. They are always quick to respond, show up when they say they will and the cost is reasonable and fair. I can't say enough good things about Adan. Every time he has worked at our house, he is so pleasant, efficient, and helpful. He has a great attitude and is very professional. These are very rare qualities in this day and age, so kudos to Adan and The Complete Backyard!
reviews.author: WILKERSON MUSIC

reviews.text:
Above and BEYOND! Exceptional attention to detail! They were incredibly patient with us! Helped us design our dream pool, using the best quality materials,  and the end result EXCEEDED our expectations! What an incredible and professional crew! Owner, Ross Woerner was hands on every step of the way! It’s PERFECT! Really transformed our backyard!
Despite the wettest winter in history, meaning it rained for two months straight! They still stayed in track and finished way ahead of when we were expecting! Thank you The Complete Backyard!
reviews.author: Erin Boggs

reviews.text: I called and set up an appointment for complete backyard design - estimate 100,000 job.  They scheduled a date for a consultation and then basically disappeared.  I called twice and no one could provide any insight to my appointment.  I was basically begging them to take my money and they could not respond.  I am moving on.  Buyer beware.
reviews.author: Pam Winn

reviews.text: The complete backyard does beautiful designs and very professional work. I can't wait to see my next projects outcome. Contact RJ for any of your backyard or pool needs and you will not be disappointed
reviews.author: Brendan McCallan

reviews.text: These guys are great!!! Would use them again without question. We researched several companies and The Complete Backyard came out on top across the board on all of our projects. Constantly have people just stop and ask who built our pool and outdoor living area because they are so impressed with what they see.
reviews.author: Kim McNally

reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful staff, service, and prices!  Our pool pump went out during the winter storm and within 3 hours of contacting them, they came out to diagnose it and repaired it the same day.   The entire staff is friendly, helpful and knowledgeable.
reviews.author: Mike Jennings

reviews.text: Our pool guys did not show last week. I called the company and they said we were in the pool so they could not service. However, we waited to swim to well after 3 and the video recording I have of the entrance never shows a service truck.  Never once did anyone say sorry, care about me canceling, or seem to have any customer service. For the price I find this unacceptable EDIT- the owner of the company reached out to me and apologized. Mistakes happen, and when my pool was serviced it was great. The owner assured me the staff would be spoken to.
reviews.author: Lea Anne Roach

reviews.text: We had our pool built in 2021 and still three years later, the customer service is amazing. They are very responsive, professional, and easy to work with.
reviews.author: Allison Smith

reviews.text: From the design, sales, and service aspects, these guys knocked it out of the park! I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone. If you’re looking for a pool builder, stop - you won’t find anyone better.
reviews.author: Timothy Schenker

reviews.text: Great experience!  Staff were very professional and knowledgeable during the whole process.
reviews.author: William Lambert

reviews.text: Very good experience from start to finish. Pool was completed on time and on budget.
reviews.author: Len Lobaito

data.summary: The reviews for The Complete Backyard appear highly authentic. The vast majority are detailed, specific, and emotionally genuine 5-star reviews from satisfied customers. The few negative reviews present credible, specific complaints about communication and service disputes, which the company has addressed professionally. There is no evidence of review manipulation; the profile is consistent with a successful, quality contractor with minor, normal customer service hiccups.
fake_signals: One review (Charlie Box) references a 25-year-old pool, which is unusual for a review of a current contractor unless it's a longevity testimonial. However, the content is specific and emotional, reducing suspicion.
authentic_signals: Extensive specific details: project managers named (Dave, RJ, Gilbert), project types (pools, patios, pergolas, outdoor kitchens), timelines, supply chain issues
Varied writing styles and perspectives from different customers
Mix of overwhelmingly positive feedback with specific, credible complaints
Owner provides professional, apologetic responses to negative feedback
Emotional authenticity in reviews expressing joy and satisfaction
complaint_patterns: Dispute over service recommendations (acid wash vs. replaster)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google, Yelp, and Houzz. The slight variation (4.8 vs 4.2) is minor and likely due to Yelp's lower review count (5). No BBB profile found, so no discrepancy.
